style: Stylized 3D animated feature film still in the style of a modern Pixar/Illumination movie, smooth stylized shapes, big expressive cartoon eyes, clean appealing character design, soft cinematic lighting with warm highlights, dark luxury color palette (black, burgundy, gold), shallow depth of field, anthropomorphic fruit- and vegetable-headed characters with realistic human bodies, vertical 9:16 composition, no text except the glowing forehead displays and the written props mentioned
